summary: The Hackett Group filed an 8-K to report entry into a Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with Bank of America, increasing revolving borrowing capacity by $25 million to $125 million and extending maturity to August 3, 2031. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation. The filing also includes results of operations and financial statements. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is present. The credit agreement includes standard covenants and guarantees. This is an operational financing arrangement, not a transformative corporate event.
